jobDescription: Carrow Parcel delivers around 250,000 parcels a day from 30 depots. The Route Planning engineer maintains the services that build each driver's daily route, integrates address and traffic data, releases changes to the live planning service ahead of the morning dispatch and covers the depot-support rota. Planning changes are judged on their effect on on-time delivery, and the engineer is expected to show that effect. The planning team has five engineers, most route builds finish by 05:00, and releases to the planner are frozen during the pre-Christmas peak.
requirements: Maintains route-planning services in Kotlin, Java or Python.
Integrates third-party address or traffic data with validation.
Has released changes to a live operational planning system and supported them through the first operating days.
Takes part in an operational support rota for depot users.
Measures the effect of planning changes on on-time delivery rates.

evidence.text: Backend Developer, Tollgate Logistics, March 2020 to February 2024. Maintained the Kotlin service that sequences stops for 1,100 van routes each morning across 14 depots, including its handling of collection stops and vehicle-capacity limits.
Added a postcode-validation step to the address import that quarantines records failing the national address file lookup for manual review and produces a daily exception list for the depot teams.

Released the delivery time-window constraint to the live route planner on 6 June 2023 under change ticket OPS-3318, deploying in the 02:00 maintenance window and watching the first three morning planning runs with the depot leads.
Covered the depot-support rota one week in four from 2022, answering planners' questions and fixing failed route builds before dispatch, and writing a short note in the rota log after each shift.
Compared planned route length for the four weeks before and after the time-window change, using the planner's own output files; the comparison was shared with the depot operations manager.

Work sample: the release record for OPS-3318, containing the change-board approval, the deployment log from the 02:00 window, the checklist for the three monitored planning runs and a short incident note about one depot whose routes were rebuilt by hand on the first morning.
HR verification note: Tollgate Logistics' HR team confirmed by email to our recruiter that the candidate was employed from March 2020 to February 2024.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate can visit depots by car and is available to start in December after a four-week notice period.
